## Scrapers

- [Scrapers | Scraplex](https://scraplex.com/scrapers): Ready-made scrapers for Daraz, YouTube and Google Maps. Each runs on Apify and charges per result.
- [Daraz Product Scraper | Scraplex](https://scraplex.com/scrapers/daraz-product-scraper): Products, prices, sellers and stock from Daraz search and category pages. $1.00 per 1,000 results.
- [YouTube Comments Scraper | Scraplex](https://scraplex.com/scrapers/youtube-comments-scraper): Comments and replies from any video or Short, with video and channel details. $0.50 per 1,000 results.
- [Daraz Product Review Scraper | Scraplex](https://scraplex.com/scrapers/daraz-product-review-scraper): Review text, star ratings, photos and votes for any Daraz product. $1.00 per 1,000 reviews.
- [Google Maps Places & Reviews Scraper | Scraplex](https://scraplex.com/scrapers/google-maps-scraper): Business listings and their reviews from Google Maps, in one run. $3.00 per 1,000 results.
